<thought>To propose a three‑step retrosynthesis we need templates for:
1. Amide formation (break a carboxylic acid → amide).
2. Doebner modification (aldehyde + malonic acid → α,β‑unsaturated carboxylic acid).
3. Sulfonamide formation (amine + sulfonyl chloride → sulfonamide).

I will locate suitable retrosynthetic templates for each transformation using the catalog search tool.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["carboxylic_acid"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["amide"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
